name: Data on force-dependent structural changes of chromatin fibers measured with magnetic tweezers
description: The data here show force-extension (FE) traces of chromatin fibers as measured with magnetic tweezers, covering the force regime from 0 pN to 27 pN.

contacts.affiliation: Institute of Physics, Academia Sinica, Taipei, Taiwan
